case_title: STEINMAN JEROME VS GRIDLEY ARNOLD DBA GRIDLEY REALTY AND CABLE CAR

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY STEINMAN JEROME AS TO DEFENDANT GRIDLEY ARNOLD DBA GRIDLEY REALTY AND CABLE CAR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-13-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
POS ON ARNOLD GRIDLEY SUB-SERVED.NO MAILING.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF STEINMAN JEROME IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GRIDLEY ARNOLD DBA GRIDLEY REALTY AND CABLE CAR STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION DENIED BY JUDGE MALLEN
